## How to use this deck {.smaller}

Show this deck on the room screen during the whole course day. Each slide shows one slot: the activity, the time, the duration, the format, the lead, and a countdown to the end of the slot.

- The deck follows the local clock. It moves to the current slot by itself.
- A manual move with the arrow keys stops follow mode. Press `C` to follow the clock again.
- The group runs late? Press `]` to shift the schedule one minute later. Press `[` to shift it one minute earlier.
- Press `?` for all keyboard shortcuts.

The times come from the timetable of the course day in `data/schedule.yml`. Show the other decks in a second window during the Lens inputs.

::: notes
Open the deck before the participants arrive. Press `F` for full screen. The status line at the bottom right shows the clock, the follow mode, and the shift.
:::
